name: OpenCode Go subscription via opencode run
role: secondary executor: mechanical/docs/test work (difficulty 1-2), independent non-GPT reviews, Codex spillover, >272k context
binary_resolution: OPENSWARM_OPENCODE_BIN, else /opt/homebrew/bin or /usr/local/bin opencode (bypasses interactive shell wrappers), else $PATH
models_source: opencode models opencode-go --verbose (live: price, context, variants, release_date, toolcall)
tiering: terciles of output price among usable models; newest release preferred within a tier
plan_source: auto: 'go' unless 30d spend on a model exceeds the Go cap without a cut-off -> 'plus'
quota_source: per-model spend in ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db (read-only; local_sources.opencode_db) vs docs limits (5h=20%, 7d=50%, 30d=100% of monthly)
quota_blind_spot: traffic that reaches OpenCode Go outside `opencode run` (e.g. through a proxy) is not counted; 429s trip a 30-min breaker
streaming_events: tool_use is emitted AFTER a tool finishes -> RISK alerts are post-hoc for opencode
dataBoundary: worktree + opencode.ai gateway + upstream model vendor
